name: How do I know if I need a sump pump installed?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a sump pump installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: You likely need a sump pump if your home experiences basement or crawl space flooding, has damp walls, or a consistently musty odor, all signs of excess moisture. Even if you haven't flooded before, if your home is in a low-lying area or has a high water table, a sump pump can offer crucial protection. A key preparation step is to observe your property during heavy rainfall or after snowmelt (if applicable), noting any areas where water collects or drains slowly near your foundation. A professional assessment can also determine the specific needs based on your home's unique situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess for basement/crawl space flooding, dampness, or musty odors; homes in low-lying areas or with high water tables also benefit. Observing water collection during rain is a good preparation step.
